description_en: Creates a scaling rule. The purpose of a scaling rule is determined by its type and can be used to trigger a scaling activity or intelligently configure the boundary values of a scaling group. You can create different types of scaling rules based on your business requirements. For example, if you only need to configure the boundary values of a scaling group, select the predictive scaling rule type
description_zh: 伸缩规则的作用由伸缩规则的类型来决定，可用于触发伸缩活动或者智能设置伸缩组边界值。根据不同业务需求，通过调用API CreateScalingRule创建不同类型的伸缩规则，例如，业务需要只能设置伸缩组边界值，建议您选择预测规则类型
name: CreateScalingRule

parameters.help_en: The ID of the scaling group to which the scaling rule belongs
parameters.help_zh: 伸缩规则所属伸缩组的ID
parameters.name: scaling_group_id

parameters.help_en:
The name of the scaling rule. The name must be 2 to 64 characters in length and can contain letters, digits, underscores (_), hyphens (-), and periods (.). It must start with a letter, digit, or Chinese character.

The name of a scaling rule must be unique within a scaling group in a region for an Alibaba Cloud account.

If this parameter is not specified, the value of ScalingRuleId is used by default
parameters.help_zh:
伸缩规则的名称，2~64个英文或中文字符，以数字、大小字母或中文开头，可包含数字、下划线（_）、连字符（-）或点号（.）。

同一用户账号同一地域同一伸缩组内伸缩规则唯一。

如果没有指定该参数，默认值为ScalingRuleId的值
parameters.name: scaling_rule_name

parameters.help_en:
The cooldown time of the scaling rule. This parameter is applicable only to simple scaling rules. Valid values: 0 to 86400. Unit: seconds.

Default value: none
parameters.help_zh:
伸缩规则的冷却时间，仅适用于简单规则。取值范围：0~86400，单位：秒。

默认值：空
parameters.name: cooldown

parameters.help_en: The minimum number of instances to be adjusted. This parameter takes effect only when the scaling rule type is SimpleScalingRule or StepScalingRule and AdjustmentType is set to PercentChangeInCapacity
parameters.help_zh: 伸缩规则最小调整实例数，仅当伸缩规则类型为SimpleScalingRule或StepScalingRule，且AdjustmentType为PercentChangeInCapacity时生效
parameters.name: min_adjustment_magnitude

parameters.help_en:
The adjustment method of the scaling rule. This parameter is required for simple scaling rules and step scaling rules. Valid values:

QuantityChangeInCapacity: adds or removes a specified number of ECS instances.
PercentChangeInCapacity: adds or removes a specified percentage of ECS instances.
TotalCapacity: adjusts the number of ECS instances in the scaling group to a specified number
parameters.help_zh:
伸缩规则的调整方式，适用于简单规则和步进规则，且此时该项必选。取值范围：

QuantityChangeInCapacity：增加或减少指定数量的ECS实例。
PercentChangeInCapacity：增加或减少指定比例的ECS实例。
TotalCapacity：将当前伸缩组的ECS实例数量调整到指定数量
parameters.name: adjustment_type

parameters.help_en:
The adjustment value of the scaling rule. This parameter is required for simple scaling rules and step scaling rules. The number of ECS instances adjusted in a single operation cannot exceed 1,000. Valid values vary based on the adjustment method:
QuantityChangeInCapacity: -1000 to 1000.
PercentChangeInCapacity: -100 to 10000.
TotalCapacity: 0 to 2000
parameters.help_zh:
伸缩规则的调整值，适用于简单规则和步进规则，且此时该项必选。任何情况下，单次调整的ECS实例台数都不能超过1000。不同调整方式对应的取值范围：
QuantityChangeInCapacity：-1000~1000。
PercentChangeInCapacity：-100~10000。
TotalCapacity：0~2000
parameters.name: adjustment_value

parameters.help_en:
The type of the scaling rule. Valid values:

SimpleScalingRule: simple scaling rule. Adjusts the number of ECS or ECI instances based on the adjustment method (AdjustmentType) and adjustment value (AdjustmentValue).
TargetTrackingScalingRule: target tracking scaling rule. Dynamically calculates the number of ECS or ECI instances for scale-out or scale-in based on a predefined metric (MetricName) to keep the metric value close to the target value (TargetValue).
StepScalingRule: step scaling rule. Provides a step-by-step scaling method based on thresholds and metric values.
PredictiveScalingRule: predictive scaling rule. Analyzes historical monitoring data of the scaling group based on machine learning capabilities to predict future metric values, and supports the automatic creation of scheduled tasks to configure the boundary values of the scaling group.

Default value: SimpleScalingRule
parameters.help_zh:
伸缩规则类型，取值范围：

SimpleScalingRule：简单规则。根据调整方式（AdjustmentType）和调整值（AdjustmentValue）调整ECS或ECI实例数量。
TargetTrackingScalingRule：目标追踪规则。根据预定义监控（MetricName）项动态计算需要扩缩容的ECS或ECI实例数量，尽量将预定义监控项的指标值维持在目标值（TargetValue）附近。
StepScalingRule：步进规则，根据阈值和指标值提供分步扩展方式。
PredictiveScalingRule：预测规则，基于机器学习能力分析伸缩组的历史监控数据预测未来监控指标值，并支持自动创建定时任务设置伸缩组边界。

默认值：SimpleScalingRule
parameters.name: scaling_rule_type

parameters.help_en:
The warmup time of instances. This parameter is applicable to target tracking scaling rules and step scaling rules. ECS instances in the warmup state are added to the scaling group normally, but they do not report monitoring data to CloudMonitor during the warmup period.

When dynamically calculating the number of ECS instances to be scaled, instances in the warmup state are not counted in the current number of instances.

Valid values: 0 to 86400. Unit: seconds.

Default value: 300
parameters.help_zh:
实例预热时间，适用于目标追踪规则和步进规则。处于预热状态的ECS实例将正常的加入伸缩组，但是期间将不会向云监控上报监控数据。

动态计算需要扩缩容的ECS实例数量时，处于预热状态的实例不计入现有实例数量。

取值范围：0~86400，单位：秒。

默认值：300
parameters.name: estimated_instance_warmup

parameters.help_en:
The predefined metric. This parameter is required for target tracking scaling rules and predictive scaling rules.

Valid values for target tracking scaling rules: 
CpuUtilizationAgent: (Agent) CPU utilization (recommended).
MemoryUtilization: (Agent) memory usage (recommended).
CpuUtilization: (ECS) average CPU utilization.
IntranetTx: (ECS) average outbound traffic over the internal network.
IntranetRx: (ECS) average inbound traffic over the internal network.
VpcInternetTx: (ECS) average outbound traffic over the Internet.
VpcInternetRx: (ECS) average inbound traffic over the Internet.
LoadBalancerRealServerAverageQps: (ALB) average QPS per backend server in a server group.

Valid values for predictive scaling rules: 
CpuUtilization: (ECS) average CPU utilization.
IntranetRx: (ECS) average inbound traffic over the internal network.
IntranetTx: (ECS) average outbound traffic over the internal network.

For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/74854.html
parameters.help_zh:
预定义监控项，适用于目标追踪规则和预测规则，且此时该项必选。

目标追踪规则取值范围： 
CpuUtilizationAgent：（Agent）CPU使用率（推荐）。
MemoryUtilization：（Agent）内存（推荐）。
CpuUtilization：（ECS）平均CPU使用率。
IntranetTx：（ECS）内网出流量的平均值。
IntranetRx：（ECS）内网入流量的平均值。
VpcInternetTx：（ECS）公网出流量的平均值。
VpcInternetRx：（ECS）公网入流量的平均值。
LoadBalancerRealServerAverageQps：（ALB）服务器组单机QPS。

预测规则取值范围： 
CpuUtilization：（ECS）平均CPU使用率。
IntranetRx：（ECS）内网入流量平均值。
IntranetTx ：（ECS）内网出流量平均值。

更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/74854.html
parameters.name: metric_name

parameters.help_en: The target value. This parameter is required for target tracking scaling rules and predictive scaling rules. The value of TargetValue can be rounded to three decimal places and must be greater than 0
parameters.help_zh: 目标值，适用于目标追踪规则和预测规则，且此时该项必选。TargetValue最多保留小数点后三位，且必须大于0
parameters.name: target_value

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to disable scale-in. This parameter is applicable only to target tracking scaling rules.

Default value: false
parameters.help_zh:
是否禁用缩容，仅适用于目标追踪规则。

默认值：false
parameters.name: disable_scale_in

parameters.help_en:
After a target tracking scaling rule is created, an event-triggered task is automatically created. This parameter specifies the number of consecutive times the threshold condition must be met before the corresponding scale-in event-triggered task triggers an alert.

Default value: 15
parameters.help_zh:
创建目标追踪规则后，会自动创建报警任务。本参数用于指定对应的缩容报警任务触发报警时，所需连续满足阈值条件的次数。

默认值：15
parameters.name: scale_in_evaluation_count

parameters.help_en:
After a target tracking scaling rule is created, an event-triggered task is automatically created. This parameter specifies the number of consecutive times the threshold condition must be met before the corresponding scale-out event-triggered task triggers an alert.

Default value: 3
parameters.help_zh:
创建目标追踪规则后，会自动创建报警任务。本参数用于指定对应的扩容报警任务触发报警时，所需连续满足阈值条件的次数。

默认值：3
parameters.name: scale_out_evaluation_count

parameters.help_en:
The mode of the predictive scaling rule. Valid values:

PredictAndScale: generates prediction results and creates predictive tasks.
PredictOnly: generates prediction results but does not create predictive tasks.

Default value: PredictAndScale
parameters.help_zh:
预测规则的模式，取值范围：

PredictAndScale：产生预测结果并创建预测任务。
PredictOnly：产生预测结果，但不会创建预测任务。

默认值：PredictAndScale
parameters.name: predictive_scaling_mode

parameters.help_en:
The processing method for the maximum value of the predictive scaling rule. Valid values:

MaxOverridePredictiveValue: The initial maximum value overrides the predicted value. If the predicted value is greater than the initial maximum value, the maximum value of the predictive task uses the initial maximum value.
PredictiveValueOverrideMax: The predicted value overrides the initial maximum value. If the predicted value is greater than the initial maximum value, the maximum value of the predictive task uses the predicted value.
PredictiveValueOverrideMaxWithBuffer: A buffer ratio is added to the predicted value. The predicted value is increased by the ratio specified by PredictiveValueBuffer. If the increased value is greater than the initial maximum value, the increased value is used.

Default value: MaxOverridePredictiveValue
parameters.help_zh:
预测规则最大值处理方式，取值范围：

MaxOverridePredictiveValue：初始最大值会覆盖预测值。预测值大于初始最大值时，预测任务的最大值采用初始最大值。
PredictiveValueOverrideMax：预测值会覆盖初始最大值。预测值大于初始最大值时，预测任务的最大值采用预测值。
PredictiveValueOverrideMaxWithBuffer：预测值会附加一定比例。预测值会按照PredictiveValueBuffer比例增加，当增加后的值大于初始最大值时，会采用增加后的值。

默认值：MaxOverridePredictiveValue
parameters.name: predictive_value_behavior

parameters.help_en:
This parameter takes effect only when `PredictiveValueBehavior` is set to `PredictiveValueOverrideMaxWithBuffer`. The predicted value is increased by this ratio. If the increased value is greater than the initial maximum value, the increased value is used. Valid values: 0 to 100.

Default value: 0
parameters.help_zh:
`PredictiveValueBehavior`为`PredictiveValueOverrideMaxWithBuffer`时生效，预测值会按照该比例增加，当增加后的值大于初始最大值时，会采用增加后的值。取值范围：0~100。

默认值：0
parameters.name: predictive_value_buffer

parameters.help_en:
The predictive tasks automatically created by predictive scaling rules are executed on the hour by default. You can set the pre-startup time to execute the predictive tasks in advance and prepare resources beforehand. Valid values: 0 to 60. Unit: minutes.

Default value: 0
parameters.help_zh:
预测规则自动创建的预测任务默认均在整点执行，您可以设置预启动时间提前执行预测任务，预先准备资源。取值范围：0~60，单位：分钟。

默认值：0
parameters.name: predictive_task_buffer_time

parameters.help_en:
The maximum number of instances in the scaling group. This parameter is used in combination with `PredictiveValueBehavior`.

Default value: the maximum number of instances in the scaling group (the value of MaxSize)
parameters.help_zh:
伸缩组实例数上限，和`PredictiveValueBehavior`结合使用。

默认值为伸缩组最大实例数（MaxSize的值）
parameters.name: initial_max_size

fields.help_en: The lower boundary of the step adjustment. This parameter is applicable only to step scaling rules. Valid values: -9.999999E18 to 9.999999E18
fields.help_zh: 分步步骤的下边界，仅适用于步进规则。取值范围：-9.999999E18~9.999999E18
fields.name: metric_interval_lower_bound

fields.help_en: The upper boundary of the step adjustment. Valid values: -9.999999E18 to 9.999999E18
fields.name: metric_interval_upper_bound

fields.help_en: The number of instances to be scaled for the step adjustment. This parameter is applicable only to step scaling rules
fields.help_zh: 分步步骤对应的实例扩展数量，仅适用于步进规则
fields.name: scaling_adjustment

parameters.help_en: The collection of instance scaling information corresponding to step adjustments
parameters.help_zh: 分步步骤对应的实例扩展信息组成的集合
parameters.name: step_adjustments

parameters.help_zh: 伸缩组所属的地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

fields.help_zh: 监控项关联的维度信息键

fields.help_zh: 监控项关联的维度信息值

For example, the LoadBalancerRealServerAverageQps metric requires the dimension key-value information of rulePool
parameters.help_zh: 监控项维度信息值，适用于目标追踪规则，当监控项需额外维度信息时设置，例如LoadBalancerRealServerAverageQps监控项需指定rulePool维度键值信息

parameters.help_en:
The type of the metric. Valid values:

system: uses system metrics of CloudMonitor.
custom: uses custom metrics reported to CloudMonitor.
hybrid: uses metrics of Hybrid Cloud Monitoring
parameters.help_zh:
监控项类型。取值范围：

system：使用云监控系统指标。
custom：使用上报到云监控的自定义指标。
hybrid：使用企业云监控的指标
parameters.name: metric_type

The ID of the monitoring metrics repository for Hybrid Cloud Monitoring.

For more information about managing monitoring metrics repositories, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/217606.html
parameters.help_zh:
企业云监控指标仓库id。

管理指标仓库，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/217606.html
parameters.name: hybrid_monitor_namespace

fields.name: dimension_key

fields.help_en: The dimension value of the metric

fields.help_zh: 指标纬度。用于指定指标监控的资源
fields.name: dimensions

fields.help_en:
The metric operation expression for multiple Hybrid Cloud Monitoring metrics. The calculation result of the expression is used to trigger scaling.

The operation expression must comply with the Reverse Polish Notation (RPN) specification, and only the `+`, `-`, `*`, and `/` operators are supported
fields.help_zh:
多个企业云监控指标的公制运算表达式，表达式的计算结果将用于触发扩缩容。

运算表达式需满足逆波兰表达式（RPN）规范，并且操作符只支持`+ - * /`
fields.name: expression

fields.help_en: The reference ID of the metric in the metric operation expression
fields.help_zh: 公制运算表达式中指标的引用id

fields.help_zh: 企业云监控指标仓库中的指标名称

fields.help_en:
The statistical method of the metric. Valid values:
Average: the average value of all data points within the specified period.
Minimum: the minimum value of all data points within the specified period.
Maximum: the maximum value of all data points within the specified period
fields.help_zh:
指标的统计方式。取值范围：
Average：指定区间内所有点的平均值。
Minimum：指定区间内所有点的最小值。
Maximum：指定区间内所有点的最大值
fields.name: statistic

parameters.help_zh: 企业云监控指标设置。如何设置，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2852162.html

目标追踪规则中统计监控项数据的周期，单位：秒。取值范围：

15。
60。
120。
300。
900。
